detail.body:
## Overview

Add tool-calling metrics to Chat Completions and Messages rendering, plus linked traces for the render server's render, tokenize/detokenize, and derender HTTP endpoints. Complements the HTTP tokenizer client in [llm-d-router#3374](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-router/pull/3374).

## Claims

- Count validated tool-field render attempts with `vllm:tool_call_render_requests_total`, labeled by served model, API surface, and rendered/error outcome.
- Honor the existing OTLP configuration and emit W3C-linked server spans for Chat Completions, Messages, Completions, and Responses render; tokenize/detokenize; and Chat/Completions derender (streaming and non-streaming). Spans for tool-bearing Chat Completions and Messages render requests carry sanitized presence, count, choice, API surface, and outcome attributes under `vllm.tool_calling.*`, aligned with the planned inference-tracing PR.
- Keep counting independent of tracing, without changing rendering or error handling. Exclude non-tool requests from tool counters and summary attributes.

## Validation

128 tests passed, including real CPU rendering and OTLP export. Coverage includes Chat Completions and Messages tool requests, tool-choice policies, success/error outcomes, disabled/unsampled tracing, and sensitive-value exclusion. Applicable pre-commit hooks passed. Additional coverage checks linked spans for tokenize/detokenize, Completions/Responses render, and streaming/non-streaming Chat/Completions derender.

Reproduce the test selection in an installed CPU environment:

```
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_render.py \
  tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_launch_render.py \
  tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_render_tracing.py \
  --confcutdir=tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render -q
```

Local macOS validation used the renderer’s Python entry point instead of the unavailable vllm console command. Tests are covered by the existing Buildkite scale-out entrypoint suite.

## Details

Adapts the minimal tracing foundation from [#51747](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51747) with attribution preserved. Tool metrics apply to Chat Completions and Messages render requests; the other endpoints receive request spans without tool-specific attributes.

Unlike http_requests_total, the counter separates tool-field render attempts from non-tool requests independently of trace sampling. It cannot detect fields dropped or changed upstream.

Telemetry reads validated request objects without rereading bodies or exporting tool names, schemas, arguments, or exception text. Existing request/error logging is unchanged.

rendered means rendering succeeded – not per-field preservation or arbitrary-template equivalence. Controlled-template tests validate rendering intent. Pre-handler validation failures are not counted as render outcomes.

———

- [ ] Code Quality and Style: Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] Pull Request Contents: Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@@ -37,6 +37,43 @@ The following metrics are exposed:
 
 --8<-- "gen:metrics-general"
 
+## HTTP Render Tool-Calling Observability
+
+`/v1/chat/completions/render` and `/v1/messages/render` expose
+`vllm:tool_call_render_requests_total` on `/metrics`. It counts validated
+requests with explicitly provided, non-null tool fields once per render
+attempt, including requests with `tool_choice=none`.
+
+Labels are the configured served `model_name`, `api_surface` (`chat_completions`
+or `messages`), and `status` (`rendered` or `error`). All four combinations are
+initialized to zero at startup. `rendered` means the render
+handler succeeded; `error` covers returned errors and interrupted/failed
+handlers. Validation errors before the handler runs are not counted.
+Non-tool requests are excluded, and counting does not require tracing.
+
+This provides tool-specific totals that `http_requests_total` does not separate,
+even when traces are unsampled or disabled. It observes only requests received
+by this server; it cannot detect tool fields dropped or changed upstream.
+
+Configure the render server's existing `--otlp-traces-endpoint` option to
+export W3C-linked server spans for rendering, tokenization, detokenization,
+and derendering. Tool-summary attributes are limited to Chat Completions
+and Messages render requests. Recording spans for tool requests include
+`vllm.tool_calling.present`, `vllm.tool_calling.tool_count`,
+`vllm.tool_calling.tool_choice`, `vllm.tool_calling.api_surface`, and
+`vllm.tool_calling.render_status`. Choices are
+normalized to `unset`, `auto`, `none`, `required`, `named`, or `other`;
+Messages `any` maps to `required` and `tool` maps to `named`.
+Names, schemas, arguments, bodies, and exception text are not included in
+these server-span attributes or metric labels. Existing request/error logging
+is unchanged.
+
+These observations confirm server receipt and render outcome, not semantic
+preservation by arbitrary templates. Template-intent tests must check the
+rendered metadata and tool-choice policy, including intentional tool exclusion
+when `--exclude-tools-when-tool-choice-none` is enabled. This is separate from
+inference tool-call response metrics.
+
 ## Speculative Decoding Metrics

+        lambda *args, **kwargs: provider.get_tracer("test.render"),
+    )
+    if request.param == "disabled":
+        monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.tracing.otel._IS_OTEL_AVAILABLE", False)
+    yield exporter, request.param == "recording"
+    provider.shutdown()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api_surface", ["chat_completions", "messages"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("outcome", ["rendered", "returned_error", "raised_error"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tool_request", [False, True, None], ids=["plain", "named", "null"]
+)
+async def test_render_tool_outcomes(api_surface, outcome, tool_request, render_spans):
+    """Count each tool render once without exposing request or error values."""
+    app = FastAPI()
+    app.include_router(router)
+    serving = _build_serving_render()
+    serving.model_config.model = MODEL_NAME
+    serving.model_config.served_model_name = SERVED_MODEL_NAME
+    app.state.serving_render = serving
+    result = {"token_ids": [7, 8, 9]}
+    handler = AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(model_dump=lambda: result))
+    if outcome == "returned_error":
+        handler.return_value = serving.create_error_response("private-render-error")
+    elif outcome == "raised_error":
+        handler.side_effect = RuntimeError("private-render-error")
+    payload: dict[str, object] = {
+        "model": "private-request-model",
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "private-prompt"}],
+    }
+    if api_surface == "messages":
+        serving.render_messages_request = handler
+        payload["max_tokens"] = 1
+        route = "/v1/messages/render"
+        tool: dict[str, object] = {
+            "name": "private-tool",
+            "input_schema": {"type": "object"},
+        }
+        choice: dict[str, object] = {"type": "tool", "name": "private-tool"}
+    else:
+        serving.render_chat_request = handler
+        route = "/v1/chat/completions/render"
+        tool = {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {"name": "private-tool", "parameters": {"type": "object"}},
+        }
+        choice = {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "private-tool"}}
+    if tool_request:
+        payload.update(tools=[tool], tool_choice=choice)
+    elif tool_request is None:
+        payload.update(tools=None, tool_choice=None)
+    labels = {
+        "model_name": SERVED_MODEL_NAME,
+        "api_surface": api_surface,
+        "status": "rendered" if outcome == "rendered" else "error",
+    }
+    metric = "vllm:tool_call_render_requests_total"
+    before = REGISTRY.get_sample_value(metric, labels) or 0
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(
+        transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
+    ) as client:
+        if outcome == "raised_error":
+            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="private-render-error"):
+                await client.post(
+                    route, json=payload, headers={"traceparent": TRACEPARENT}
+                )
+        else:
+            response = await client.post(
+                route, json=payload, headers={"traceparent": TRACEPARENT}
+            )
+            assert response.status_code == (200 if outcome == "rendered" else 400)
+            if outcome == "rendered":
+                assert response.json() == result
+    handler.assert_awaited_once()
+    request, _ = handler.call_args.args
+    assert request.model == payload["model"]
+    assert request.tools is not None if tool_request else request.tools is None
+    assert (REGISTRY.get_sample_value(metric, labels) or 0) - before == int(
+        bool(tool_request)
+    )
+    for collector in REGISTRY.collect():
+        for sample in collector.samples:
+            if sample.name == metric:
+                assert set(sample.labels) == {"model_name", "api_surface", "status"}
+                assert sample.labels["model_name"] == SERVED_MODEL_NAME
+                assert "private" not in str(sample.labels)
+    exporter, recording = render_spans
+    spans = exporter.get_finished_spans()
+    if recording:
+        assert len(spans) == 1
+        span = spans[0]
+        assert span.kind == SpanKind.SERVER
+        assert span.context.trace_id == int(TRACEPARENT.split("-")[1], 16)
+        assert span.parent.span_id == int(TRACEPARENT.split("-")[2], 16)
+        assert dict(span.attributes) == (
+            {
+                "vllm.tool_calling.present": True,
+                "vllm.tool_calling.tool_count": 1,
+                "vllm.tool_calling.tool_choice": "named",
+                "vllm.tool_calling.api_surface": api_surface,
+                "vllm.tool_calling.render_status": labels["status"],
+            }
+            if tool_request
+            else {}
+        )
+        assert not span.events
+        assert span.status.status_code == (
+            StatusCode.UNSET if outcome == "rendered" else StatusCode.ERROR
+        )
+        assert not span.status.description
+    else:
+        assert not spans

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tracing tests for the GPU-less render server (`vllm launch render`)."""
+
+import json
+import socket
+import time
+from collections.abc import Generator
+from concurrent import futures
+
+import grpc
+import httpx
+import pytest
+import pytest_asyncio
+from opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.trace_service_pb2_grpc import (
+    add_TraceServiceServicer_to_server,
+)
+from opentelemetry.proto.trace.v1.trace_pb2 import Status
+from prometheus_client.parser import text_string_to_metric_families
+
+from tests.tracing.conftest import (
+    FAKE_TRACE_SERVER_ADDRESS,
+    FakeTraceService,
+)
+from tests.utils import RemoteLaunchRenderServer
+from vllm.tokenizers import get_tokenizer
+
+MODEL_NAME = "hmellor/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM"
+SERVED_MODEL_NAME = "render-test"
+TOOLS_TEMPLATE = "TOOLS={{ (tools or []) | tojson }}|END|{{ messages[0].content }}"
+
+# W3C traceparent header with a fixed trace id and parent span id.
+TRACEPARENT = "00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def trace_service() -> Generator[FakeTraceService, None, None]:
+    """Module-scoped fake OTLP trace service for the render server process."""
+    server = grpc.server(futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2))
+    service = FakeTraceService()
+    add_TraceServiceServicer_to_server(service, server)
+    server.add_insecure_port(FAKE_TRACE_SERVER_ADDRESS)
+    server.start()
+
+    host, port = FAKE_TRACE_SERVER_ADDRESS.rsplit(":", 1)
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5.0
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        try:
+            with socket.create_connection((host, int(port)), timeout=0.5):
+                break
+        except OSError:
+            time.sleep(0.1)
+
+    yield service
+
+    server.stop(grace=None)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def server(trace_service):
+    args = [
+        "--served-model-name",
+        SERVED_MODEL_NAME,
+        "--otlp-traces-endpoint",
+        FAKE_TRACE_SERVER_ADDRESS,
+        "--enable-auto-tool-choice",
+        "--tool-call-parser",
+        "hermes",
+        "--exclude-tools-when-tool-choice-none",
+        "--chat-template",
+        TOOLS_TEMPLATE,
+    ]
+    with RemoteLaunchRenderServer(
+        MODEL_NAME,
+        args,
+        max_wait_seconds=120,
+        env_dict={"OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY": "100"},
+    ) as srv:
+        # Scrape before any render requests, independent of test ordering.
+        metrics = httpx.get(srv.url_for("metrics"))
+        metrics.raise_for_status()
+        counts = {
+            (
+                sample.labels["model_name"],
+                sample.labels["api_surface"],
+                sample.labels["status"],
+            ): sample.value
+            for family in text_string_to_metric_families(metrics.text)
+            for sample in family.samples
+            if sample.name == "vllm:tool_call_render_requests_total"
+        }
+        assert counts == {
+            (SERVED_MODEL_NAME, api_surface, status): 0
+            for api_surface in ("chat_completions", "messages")
+            for status in ("rendered", "error")
+        }
+        yield srv
+
+
+@pytest_asyncio.fixture
+async def client(server):
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(
+        base_url=server.url_for(""), timeout=30.0
+    ) as http_client:
+        yield http_client
+
+
+def _wait_for_span(
+    trace_service: FakeTraceService,
+    span_name: str,
+    timeout: float = 30.0,
+) -> dict:
+    """Wait until a span with the given name has been exported."""
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        for span in trace_service.get_all_spans():
+            if span["name"] == span_name:
+                return span
+        time.sleep(0.25)
+    raise AssertionError(f"No span named '{span_name}' was exported within {timeout}s")
+
+
+def _assert_span_linked_to_trace(span: dict, traceparent: str) -> None:
+    """Assert the span belongs to the trace carried by `traceparent`."""
+    _, trace_id, parent_span_id, _ = traceparent.split("-")
+    assert span["trace_id"] == trace_id
+    assert span["parent_span_id"] == parent_span_id
+
+
+def _assert_span_status(trace_service, span_name, error):
+    spans = [
+        span
+        for request in trace_service.requests
+        for resource in request.resource_spans
+        for scope in resource.scope_spans
+        for span in scope.spans
+        if span.name == span_name
+    ]
+    assert len(spans) == 1
+    span = spans[0]
+    assert span.status.code == (
+        Status.STATUS_CODE_ERROR if error else Status.STATUS_CODE_UNSET
+    )
+    assert not span.status.message
+    assert not span.events
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("error", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "route,span_name,payload",
+    [
+        (
+            "/v1/chat/completions/render",
+            "render_chat_completion",
+            {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]},
+        ),
+        (
+            "/v1/messages/render",
+            "render_messages",
+            {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], "max_tokens": 1},
+        ),
+        ("/v1/completions/render", "render_completion", {"prompt": "Hello"}),
+        ("/v1/responses/render", "render_responses", {"input": "Hello"}),
+        ("/tokenize", "tokenize", {"prompt": "Hello"}),
+        ("/detokenize", "detokenize", {"tokens": [1]}),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_render_endpoint_span(
+    client, trace_service, route, span_name, payload, error
+):
+    """Export linked spans with failure status but no request or error content."""
+    trace_service.clear()
+    response = await client.post(
+        route,
+        headers={"traceparent": TRACEPARENT},
+        json={
+            "model": "private-invalid-model" if error else SERVED_MODEL_NAME,
+            **payload,
+        },
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == (404 if error else 200), response.text
+
+    span = _wait_for_span(trace_service, span_name)
+    _assert_span_linked_to_trace(span, TRACEPARENT)
+    assert not span["attributes"]
+    _assert_span_status(trace_service, span_name, error)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api", ["chat/completions", "completions"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("error", [False, True])
+async def test_derender_endpoint_span(client, trace_service, api, stream, error):
+    """Both derender modes retain caller trace linkage without exposing content."""
+    token_ids = get_tokenizer(MODEL_NAME).encode("Hello", add_special_tokens=False)
+    generated = {
+        "choices": [{"index": 0, "token_ids": token_ids, "finish_reason": "stop"}]
+    }
+    payload = {
+        "model": "private-invalid-model" if error else SERVED_MODEL_NAME,
+        "stream": stream,
+        "prompt_token_ids": [1],
+    }
+    if api == "chat/completions":
+        payload["chat_request"] = {
+            "model": SERVED_MODEL_NAME,
+            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+        }
+        span_name = "derender_chat_completion"
+    else:
+        span_name = "derender_completion"
+        if not stream:
+            payload["prompt_token_ids"] = [[1]]
+    if stream:
+        payload["generate_chunk"] = generated
+    elif api == "chat/completions":
+        payload["generate_response"] = generated
+    else:
+        payload["generate_responses"] = [generated]
+    trace_service.clear()
+    response = await client.post(
+        f"/v1/{api}/derender", json=payload, headers={"traceparent": TRACEPARENT}
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == (404 if error else 200), response.text
+    span = _wait_for_span(trace_service, span_name)
+    _assert_span_linked_to_trace(span, TRACEPARENT)
+    assert not span["attributes"]
+    _assert_span_status(trace_service, span_name, error)
+
+
+def _render_count(metrics: str, api_surface: str, status: str) -> float:
+    return sum(
+        sample.value
+        for family in text_string_to_metric_families(metrics)
+        for sample in family.samples
+        if sample.name == "vllm:tool_call_render_requests_total"
+        and sample.labels["model_name"] == SERVED_MODEL_NAME
+        and sample.labels["api_surface"] == api_surface
+        and sample.labels["status"] == status
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api_surface", ["chat_completions", "messages"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("choice", ["auto", "none", "required", "named"])
+async def test_render_tool_intent_and_telemetry(
+    client, trace_service, api_surface, choice
+):
+    """Real rendering preserves tool metadata/policy without exporting its values."""
+    schema = {
+        "type": "object",
+        "properties": {"private_schema_field": {"type": "string"}},
+    }
+    chat_tool = {
+        "type": "function",
+        "function": {"name": "private-render-tool", "parameters": schema},
+    }
+    payload: dict[str, object] = {
+        "model": SERVED_MODEL_NAME,
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "private-render-prompt"}],
+        "max_tokens": 1,
+        "stream": choice == "auto",
+    }
+    if api_surface == "messages":
+        payload["tools"] = [{"name": "private-render-tool", "input_schema": schema}]
+        payload["tool_choice"] = (
+            {"type": "tool", "name": "private-render-tool"}
+            if choice == "named"
+            else {"type": "any" if choice == "required" else choice}
+        )
+        route, span_name = "/v1/messages/render", "render_messages"
+    else:
+        payload["tools"] = [chat_tool]
+        payload["tool_choice"] = (
+            {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "private-render-tool"}}
+            if choice == "named"
+            else choice
+        )
+        route, span_name = "/v1/chat/completions/render", "render_chat_completion"
+    before = _render_count((await client.get("/metrics")).text, api_surface, "rendered")
+    trace_service.clear()
+    response = await client.post(
+        route, json=payload, headers={"traceparent": TRACEPARENT}
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    data = response.json()
+    rendered = get_tokenizer(MODEL_NAME).decode(data["token_ids"])
+    tools = json.loads(rendered.split("TOOLS=", 1)[1].split("|END|", 1)[0])
+    assert len(tools) == (0 if choice == "none" else 1)
+    if tools:
+        assert tools[0]["function"]["name"] == "private-render-tool"
+        assert tools[0]["function"]["parameters"] == schema
+    assert data["stream"] == payload["stream"]
+    assert data["sampling_params"]["max_tokens"] == 1
+    constraints = data["sampling_params"].get("structured_outputs")
+    if choice in ("required", "named"):
+        assert constraints and any(
+            constraints.get(field) for field in ("json", "grammar", "structural_tag")
+        ), constraints
+    span = _wait_for_span(trace_service, span_name)
+    _assert_span_linked_to_trace(span, TRACEPARENT)
+    assert span["attributes"] == {
+        "vllm.tool_calling.present": True,
+        "vllm.tool_calling.tool_count": 1,
+        "vllm.tool_calling.tool_choice": choice,
+        "vllm.tool_calling.api_surface": api_surface,
+        "vllm.tool_calling.render_status": "rendered",
+    }
+    metrics = (await client.get("/metrics")).text
+    assert _render_count(metrics, api_surface, "rendered") - before == 1
+    for value in (
+        "private-render-tool",
+        "private_schema_field",
+        "private-render-prompt",
+    ):
+        assert value not in metrics
+        assert value not in str(span)
+    _assert_span_status(trace_service, span_name, error=False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio

@sfeng33 Thanks so much for the comments – all good points!

Agreed that detecting upstream tool field drops belongs to router telemetry. 

The counter serves a separate purpose: measure tool-field requests received by vLLM and their render outcomes, independently of trace sampling.

For example, if 90 non-tool requests succeed and 10 tool requests fail, HTTP metrics show 90 successes and 10 failures, but not that every tool request failed. Sampled traces may miss those requests.

What do you think about keeping the counter for that visibility? I’ll clarify its purpose and extend tracing to the other endpoints as suggested.
@sfeng33 Added tracing spans to all endpoints and clarified the purpose of the new counter. I'm okay with dropping it if you still think it doesn't add much value. Let me know!
Thanks, that's a fair point. http_requests_total can't split by tool presence, and traces are sampled, so the counter does add something. We can keep it.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks for picking this up from #51747.

The tracing half looks right to me: the render launcher drops --otlp-traces-endpoint today, and the request span linked to the caller's traceparent is what llm-d needs. I'd keep the spans on all render-server endpoints like #51747 did, rather than only chat and messages.

I'm less sure about the counter. http_requests_total already gives success/error per render handler, so the only new fact in vllm:tool_call_render_requests_total is "the request had tool fields", and the span attributes already carry that (plus count and choice). The question in llm-d/llm-d-router#3218 is whether the router dropped or changed tool fields, and vLLM can't tell that; it only sees what arrived.
